name: leave the provided example fixture unmodified
definition: do not edit the supplied example script; the verifier hashes it and requires the original digest.
failure_mode: any edit to the fixture changes the hash and fails

name: make a password-hash probe of the protected archive
definition: Feed the archive to a tool that prints a crackable hash/metadata (in the format expected by a cracker once built).
failure_mode: An extraction that misses the archive's encryption yields no useful hash.

name: mirror the file tree into an output directory with pds
definition: create the target directory and write each encrypted file there under its original basename.
failure_mode: missing directory or renamed/moved output files fail the open checks

name: parallelize work across processes
definition: dispatch the file-hashing jobs to a process pool (not threads) so CPU-bound pbkdf2 work runs in parallel workers.
failure_mode: using threads instead of processes fails the process-evidence check
